title: origanum vulgare var. virens
intro: Origanum vulgare var. virens, commonly known as the golden oregano or green oregano, is a variety of the wild marjoram plant, belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce stress, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of O. vulgare var. virens include its ability to exhibit carminative, expectorant, and spasmolytic effects, making it a popular choice for herbal remedies. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions include carvacrol, thymol, and rosmarinic acid, which are found in the plant's leaves and essential oil.
